title: Closing a Billing Cycle on a Belrose Promotional Financing Plan
content:
# Closing a Billing Cycle on a Belrose Promotional Financing Plans

**Finance desk servicing rule.** When a billing cycle closes on a Belrose Promotional Financing Plan, the desk puts the statement for that cycle on the plan's billing history: the amount the statement presents to the customer, the date the cycle closed and the date the money is due, the entry being cycled to the month the closing date falls in. Nothing else about the plan moves; the balance and the standing are untouched. Afterwards the customer can see the statement and what it asks for.

## Invoking `issue_cycle_statement_c71da302`

The agent unlocks `issue_cycle_statement_c71da302` and calls it. One call puts one statement on the billing history for one cycle.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | What it is | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `financing_plan_id` | The reference number of the promotional financing plan record whose cycle is being closed | An identifier, read from the financing plan lookup for this customer before the call |
| `statement_amount` | The money the statement presents for the cycle | In USD as a positive number with 2 decimal places, half-up at the cent, with no currency symbol and no thousands separator; an empty value is not accepted |
| `closing_date` | The date the billing cycle closed | Written as YYYY-MM-DD in the store's own calendar dating; an empty value is not accepted |
| `payment_due_date` | The date the money the statement presents falls due | Written as YYYY-MM-DD in the store's own calendar dating; an empty value is not accepted |

**Return.** A single confirmation sentence in plain text naming the reference number minted for the new billing entry, the plan reference it was booked to, the closing date of the cycle, the date the money falls due and the amount presented in USD to two decimal places. That sentence naming the new entry reference is what indicates the statement is on the billing history.

## Points of judgement

- The call presents the figure it is given; the figure itself is worked out from the plan's records and this desk's published rules before the call.
- The entry is cycled to the month the closing date falls in, not to the month of the call.
